final_sql:
SELECT
  *
FROM ESTATES
WHERE
  property_type IN (
    'Edifici adibiti ad albergo, pensione ed attività similari',
    'Collegi, luoghi di ricovero, case di pena, caserme, conventi',
    'Ospedali, cliniche, case di cura e assimilabili'
  )
  AND surface_area >= 1600
  AND energy_class IN ('A1', 'A2', 'A3', 'A4', 'B', 'C', 'D')
  AND healthcare >= 75
  AND HAVERSINE_KM(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) <= 3.0
ORDER BY
  HAVERSINE_KM(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) ASC

requirements.description: User wants the property near healthcare services (hospitals, pharmacies, clinics). 'Near' maps to the 75th percentile of the healthcare distribution (75.06), rounded to 75.
The user prefers an energy class of D or better, so the filter includes D and every higher class (C, B, A1-A4).

typologies: Edifici adibiti ad albergo, pensione ed attività similari

requirements.description: The user explicitly requires at least 1600 sqm of gross floor area. Capacity for 30 people is not a surface requirement and was not converted to an area filter, since no verified gross-area threshold per occupant was provided by the RegulatoryAgent. The energy class preference and proximity to healthcare services are outside the reference columns and were handled as context only; 'Turin' is a city name and was not mapped to comune_code.
